description.value: Cleveland Dam is a concrete arch dam on the Capilano River in North Vancouver, forming Capilano Reservoir, the primary drinking water supply for Metro Vancouver. It sits within Capilano River Regional Park and offers a dramatic viewpoint over the canyon and river gorge below. The dam and surrounding park are a popular destination for outdoor recreationists on the North Shore, accessible via several trail networks.
